BUSINESS STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.
   D. Treat Banking as rumours only.

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

3. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Money.
   C. Say Money never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Money as rumours only.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

5. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business .

   C. Say Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Budgeting in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Budgeting in Business as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business.
   C. Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Budgeting in Business never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   C. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum.
   D. Treat Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   B. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.
   D. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

12. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business.
   B. Say Social Responsibility of Business never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

14. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

15. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Goals as rumours only.
   B. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.
